nativeGrammar.ordinaryNativeRecord: O(K): value is non-null object with Object.getPrototypeOf(value)===Object.prototype, exactly K as own enumerable DATA string fields, no extra/hidden/nonenumerable/symbol/accessor/undefined fields. Match key SET, not key order. Generic codec's null-prototype support does not widen native constructor grammar.
nativeGrammar.arrayPredicate: A(N): Object.getPrototypeOf(array)===Array.prototype, length===N, exactly own keys length and string indices0..N-1, no holes/extra/hidden/symbol/accessor/undefined index values; each index enumerable data. The intrinsic length property is the sole expected nonenumerable field. Key-set validation, not enumeration-order validation. Numeric luminance elements and numeric0/1 flags only; N frozen16 or48.
